leadText: Noriko Hidaka (Japanese: 日高のり子 Hidaka Noriko) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Noriko Hidaka (Japanese: 日高のり子 Hidaka Noriko) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Hidaka was born as Noriko Itō (伊東 範子 Itō Noriko) on May 31, 1962, in the Kudan area of , , to Western-style clothing store owners. She attended Fujimi Elementary School as a child. As an adult, she started a career as an idol singer, but eventually switched to a voice acting career. Hidaka soon became known for her roles in several Japanese anime series. In addition to voice acting, she did some narration and voice-over work. She joined and voiced characters during the original series and , most notably Tory Lund during the seventh movie. Hidaka is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
